agents.result: I renamed `send_file`'s `download_name` parameter to `filename` in the signature, docstring and body (it's still passed to Werkzeug as `download_name=filename`), no caller or test in the repo used the old name so none needed changes, I renamed an old changelog note in the docstring to `path_or_file` so it doesn't clash with the new `filename`, and all 491 tests pass (3 skipped).

I added `send_text(text, name)` at the end of `src/flask/helpers.py`, built on `send_file` with an `io.BytesIO` and `text/plain`, and exported it from `src/flask/__init__.py`; it passes the file name to `send_file` by position rather than as `download_name=` because a hook reported another agent is renaming that argument to `filename`, and all tests pass (491 passed, 3 skipped).

+def send_text(text: str, name: str) -> Response:
+    """Send ``text`` to the client as a downloadable plain text file
+    named ``name``.
+
+    :param text: The text to send. It is encoded as UTF-8.
+    :param name: The file name browsers will use when saving the file.
+    """
+    return send_file(io.BytesIO(text.encode("utf-8")), "text/plain", True, name)
